test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) water the plants (B) every morning (C) before breakfast (D) we
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4** i.e. **DABC**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject **"we"** (D), indicating who is performing the action.
 
• Next, the verb phrase **"water the plants"** (A) follows the subject, describing the action.
 
• The adverbial phrase **"every morning"** (B) specifies the frequency of the action and logically comes after the verb.
 
• Finally, **"before breakfast"** (C) indicates the time, completing the sentence with a clear temporal context.

Therefore, the correct sequence of sentence parts is **DABC**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (DCAB):** Incorrect, places the verb before the subject, which is grammatically wrong.
 
• **Option 2 (DACB):** Incorrect, misplaces the temporal phrase "before breakfast."
 
• **Option 3 (DBCA):** Incorrect, the verb placement after "every morning" is awkward and unnatural.
